newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Navan says finds gold in Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: Navan says finds gold in Bulgaria.

text.p: Irish exploration company Navan Resources Plc said on Monday that it had found significant gold bearing structures in Bulgaria.

Navan said in a statement that first quarter drilling programmes at Vrachesh and Ribnivir on the Etropole-Iskar license area, 40-50 km north west of Chelopech, established significant gold bearing structures.
It said a comprehensive geophysical survey was in progress to identify final drill targets which will follow in late summer.
Navan said drilling in the Spanish Migollas section of Almagrera's Sotiel mine had indicated a "down dip" extension of the main high grade copper zone.
"These holes indicate a down dip extension of at least 120 metres to the known mineralisation in an area of the mine that has existing development," Navan said.
It said drilling would continue and further announcements would follow on a regular basis.
